title: fix(plugin-dev): load setup/account through literal specifiers, so init() makes no main-process round trip under vitest
body:
Fixes #20376
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`DevPlugin.init()`'s setup / account app-package loop imported both packages through one variable specifier, `import(/* @vite-ignore */ spec[0])`. Under vitest a variable specifier cannot be resolved when `dev-plugin.ts` is transformed, so every call went to the main vitest process, mocked packages included: two main-process round trips per `init()`, inside every clocked test window that boots `DevPlugin`. The main process is shared by the whole run, so on a busy CI shard those requests wait on other files' work. That is the shape of the `Test Core (6/6)` red on PR #20365 (job 108779589417): the mount-refusal suite's first case timed out at 5026 ms and its second took 2336 ms, while its other four took 16-72 ms, in a package run reading `transform 74.29s, import 137.46s, tests 11.87s`.

Route A of the seat's answer on the card: each loop entry now carries its own literal loader (`() => import('@objectstack/setup')`, `() => import('@objectstack/account')`). The `try` / `catch` and `reportOptionalLoadFailure` around each load are byte-for-byte unchanged. No timeout, retry or test-arrangement change.

Files:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin.ts`: the loop only (two tuple entries, one call line, one comment block).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin-literal-imports.pin.test.ts` (new): every dynamic `import()` in `dev-plugin.ts` takes a string literal, except `organizationsPkg` (ADR-0132); read off the TypeScript AST.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin-optional-load-failure.test.ts`: one case pinning that setup / account, when they cannot be imported, still reach the absent arm (one line each at `warn`, with the resolver's code and the failing specifier, never at `error`).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/vitest.config.ts`: two anchored alias entries for `@objectstack/setup` / `@objectstack/account`, which `check:test-source-alias` requires once the specifiers are literal (see Acceptance notes).
- `.changeset/20376-plugin-dev-literal-app-imports.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-dev` `patch`.

## Takeover record

This branch was started by a dev whose seat session ran out of tokens after pushing `952e1249` and `4160ecbe`, with no PR and no report. This continuation read both commits hunk by hunk as unverified work, merged `origin/main` (`0fcb10184c`) and re-ran every measurement below itself.

- Kept: the `dev-plugin.ts` code lines, the changeset's frontmatter and `Clause-②` line, and the pin's `__dirname` seed (`4160ecbe`).
- Corrected in `917a31bc72`: the `dev-plugin.ts` comment and the changeset said the loop now loads "like every other load / package", which the deliberate `organizationsPkg` variable specifier contradicts (now: every other declared-dependency load); the changeset said the build keeps `await import("…")`, while `dist/index.mjs` and `dist/index.js` both keep a native `import("…")` inside an arrow; the pin header carried the earlier run's load timings (44.5-102.0 ms per `init()`, a 5048 ms local timeout), which this run did not re-measure, and now states the counts below plus the CI job reading, which this run read from the job log itself.
- Corrected in `35833d2a2c`: the pin's private regex comment stripper was refused by `check:comment-mask-adoption`; the pin now walks the TypeScript syntax tree (`typescript` is already a devDependency of this package).
- Added in `917a31bc72`: the absent-arm pin (no existing pin covered this loop's failure path).
- Added in `a24f6ea84c`: the two vitest alias entries (`check:test-source-alias` red without them).

## Measurements (H1-H4)

**H1: the round trips, counted.** A throwaway vite plugin (deleted after) logged every `resolveId` and `transform` the main process served, around six back-to-back `init()`s in a throwaway probe with every package mocked absent. Same method, same run shape, both legs:

| `dev-plugin.ts` | main-process requests during the six `init()`s | per `init()` |
|---|---|---|
| as on `origin/main` (blob `b132ad3f4`) | 20 | first: 10 (2 bare `resolveId`, 2 `/@fs` `resolveId`, 2 `dist/index.mjs` transforms, 4 `resolveId`s of their imports); each later: 2 (`@objectstack/setup`, `@objectstack/account`) |
| this branch, `a24f6ea84c` | 0 | 0 |

The real `dev-plugin-tenancy-mount-refusal.test.ts` under the same logger (importer `dev-plugin.ts`): on `origin/main`, 9 `resolveId`s of each package (nine `init()`s, 18 in all) plus both `dist` transforms; on this branch, none in the test phase. Every leg logged both absent-app warnings on every `init()` (6 of 6).

**H2: the pin fails when the variable specifier comes back.** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, WRAP mode, at `35833d2a2c`:

- the call line back to `await import(/* @vite-ignore */ spec[0])`: ① red (`1 failed | 2 passed`), received `[ 'spec[0]', 'organizationsPkg' ]`;
- the whole hunk back to the `origin/main` blob `b132ad3f4`: ① and ③ red (`2 failed | 1 passed`; ③ reports 12 literal loads, none of them setup / account).

Each restore was proven by the tool: blob after restore equals the HEAD blob (`1f1ac117f`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The pin reads `dev-plugin.ts`'s source text, so no `dist/` leg applies.

**H3: the absent-package path is unchanged.** The new case is green on this branch and green with `dev-plugin.ts` swapped to the `origin/main` blob (`10 passed` both), so it pins behaviour the fix preserves. It goes red when that path breaks: a silent `catch` (`if (err) continue;`) gives `1 failed | 9 passed`, and demoting the loop's `absentLevel` to `info` gives `1 failed | 9 passed`. Restores proven as above. (A first attempt at the silent-catch leg was refused by the tool, because its replacement contained its own anchor; no test ran, and it was retried with a different anchor.)

**H4: the suites pass.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-dev test` at `a24f6ea84c`: `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 86 passed (86)`, mount-refusal 6/6, failfast 9/9, tenancy-posture 6/6, optional-load-failure 10/10, security-enforcement-warning 4/4, malformed-stack-posture 4/4, `dev-plugin.test.ts` 24/24, i18n reader 20/20, the new pin 3/3.

On the way: `check:comment-mask-adoption` and `check:test-source-alias` were red on this branch's pushed state and are fixed above; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET and were re-run after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*' --concurrency=2` (71/71).

- `pnpm lint`: exit 0, no findings.
- NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI: the `Test Core`, `Dogfood`, `Build Core` and `Temporal Conformance` jobs and the workspace type-check lanes the derivation lists as CI-only.

**Declared narrowing — verification ran UNLOCKED.** `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`
could not take the shared verify lock on this host: no usable `flock`. The shared
verify lock is declared Linux-only (`flock` is util-linux, and a stock macOS does
not ship it), so the command below was run directly, without the lock —
a declared narrowing, not a silent one. No serialization guarantee held for this
run, nor for any sibling agent in this container while it ran.

    pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/plugin-dev^...' --concurrency=2
    pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-dev build
    pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*' --concurrency=2
    pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-dev typecheck
    pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-dev test
    pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-dev exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 (suite, probe and ablation runs)

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/vitest.config.ts` is not in the claim's listed surface. It is the mechanical consequence of route A: literal specifiers make both packages visible to `check:test-source-alias`, which then requires them aliased to source. The two entries are the ones the gate printed; both packages' own imports were already aliased. The absent-arm case in `dev-plugin-optional-load-failure.test.ts` is the "smallest pin" the dispatch's H3 asked for.
- **Census notes carried from the seat's answer, not re-measured under load.** `dev-plugin-malformed-stack-posture.test.ts` case 4 pays a real cold load of `objectql` and `driver-memory` inside a window widened by an explicit `60_000`, and the first case of `dev-i18n-packages-reader.test.ts` pays a first-use cost. Neither is failing (idle maxima at `a24f6ea84c`: 76 ms and 28 ms). No CPU-load generator was run on this shared host.
- **Timing.** This PR rests on the deterministic counts above and the CI job reading. The earlier run's under-load timings (on the card) were not re-measured here.
- **Same loop shape in the CLI.** `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (around line 4024) loads setup / account through the same kind of variable-specifier loop (with `webpackIgnore`). In a spawned CLI process there is no vitest main process to call, so it costs nothing there; a vitest suite that ran that branch in-process would pay the same round trip. Not measured. Noted, not filed.
- **A stale docblock sentence.** `dev-plugin.ts`'s `MODULE_NOT_FOUND_CODES` docblock says the CJS build resolves these loads through `require()`. The current `dist/index.js` keeps a native `import("…")` for every dynamic load. It is harmless, because both codes stay in the set. Noted, not filed.
- **Bundler visibility.** A consumer's bundler now sees `@objectstack/setup` and `@objectstack/account` statically, as it already saw the twelve other literal loads. Both are declared dependencies. `@objectstack/organizations`, which no framework package may declare, keeps its `webpackIgnore` variable form.
